title: Making a Mother's Day Connection
speaker: Pastor Mike Roth
description: Feeling spiritually lost or like you're groping in the darkness? Paul's encounter in Athens reveals a stunning truth: God isn't distant or unknown - He's the very atmosphere you breathe. You're not an accident of history but purposefully placed in this moment for divine reasons. What if the love you've experienced through nurturing relationships is just a glimpse of how intimately God surrounds you every day?
